hooks.command: jq -c 'if (.tool_input.command | test("^git push")) then {continue: false, stopReason: "git push is blocked — push manually when ready."} else empty end'

jq -c 'if (.tool_input.command | test("^rtk ")) then empty elif (.tool_input.command | test("^(ls|find|grep|diff|git|gh|vitest|dotnet|playwright|tsc|docker|env)( |$)")) then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", updatedInput: {command: ("rtk " + .tool_input.command)}}} else empty end'
